scope: Business knowledge extracted for reimplementation in UMI; no NEXO implementation authority survives.

rules.title: Server-authoritative quote
rules.description: The server derives prices, discounts, inclusive tax, tips, totals, change, currency, and business date.
rules.trigger: A checkout is quoted or committed.
rules.expectedBehavior: Return a versioned quote and commit only against its authoritative inputs.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Trust client-authored totals or silently accept a stale quote.

rules.title: Immutable committed sale
rules.description: Committed lines, modifiers, prices, taxes, discounts, tips, actors, and receipt facts are snapshots.
rules.trigger: Checkout commit succeeds.
rules.expectedBehavior: Freeze commercial facts and use explicit later events for corrections.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Edit or delete committed financial history.

rules.title: Optimistic checkout concurrency
rules.description: Every state-changing checkout command is conditioned on the current version.
rules.trigger: Two actors or devices modify the same checkout.
rules.expectedBehavior: One valid version wins; stale commands return a stable conflict.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Last-write-wins mutation of financial state.

rules.title: Suspend and resume preserve identity
rules.description: Suspension preserves checkout identity, version, snapshots, and branch scope.
rules.trigger: An authorized operator suspends or resumes an unpaid checkout.
rules.expectedBehavior: Resume the same checkout under current authorization and conflict checks.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Duplicate the cart or expose it across branches.
exceptions: Expired carts follow explicit expiration policy.

rules.title: Cancellation before payment only
rules.description: Only non-completed sales may be cancelled; completed sales require refund facts.
rules.trigger: Cancellation is requested.
rules.expectedBehavior: Require permission, reason, version, idempotency, and reservation release.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Cancel or erase a completed sale.

rules.title: Idempotent command replay
rules.description: A command identity is scoped by business, operation, and canonical request fingerprint.
rules.trigger: A mutation is submitted or retried.
rules.expectedBehavior: Same identity and fingerprint returns the recorded result without new effects.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Execute duplicate effects or treat an idempotency key as a permanent resource identity.

rules.title: Idempotency fingerprint conflict
rules.description: Reuse of a command identity with different input is an explicit conflict.
rules.trigger: A stored command identity receives a different canonical fingerprint.
rules.expectedBehavior: Reject with idempotency_conflict and retain the original result.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Overwrite the prior command or execute the new input.

rules.title: Unknown payment outcome is query-only
rules.description: A lost or ambiguous provider response does not authorize a new charge attempt.
rules.trigger: Provider outcome cannot be proved.
rules.expectedBehavior: Persist UNKNOWN, query by original intent, and reconcile.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Create a replacement charge merely because a response was lost.

rules.title: Payment allocation cannot exceed balance
rules.description: Captured allocations settle no more than the outstanding authoritative total.
rules.trigger: A tender allocation is recorded.
rules.expectedBehavior: Validate method, currency, amount, reference uniqueness, and remaining balance.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Count rejected, duplicate, or excessive allocations as paid.
exceptions: Cash tender may exceed balance only to derive explicit change.

rules.title: Manual terminal data minimization
rules.description: Manual terminal records contain operational references, approved amount, optional brand/last four, actor, device, and unverified reconciliation status.
rules.trigger: A cashier records a SIM-terminal payment.
rules.expectedBehavior: Persist only approved non-sensitive evidence and reconcile later.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Capture PAN, track data, CVV, terminal secrets, or raw provider payloads.

rules.title: Refund bounded by original sale
rules.description: Refundable quantity and value derive from the immutable original sale minus prior refunds.
rules.trigger: A partial or full refund is prepared.
rules.expectedBehavior: Validate owned lines, remaining amount, reason, destination, permission, and approval.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Refund more than captured or refund an unrelated allocation.

rules.title: Post-payment refund requires manager approval
rules.description: Every post-payment refund is consequential and needs command-bound second-manager approval.
rules.trigger: A post-payment refund is submitted.
rules.expectedBehavior: Require requester permission, fresh PIN, independent approval, reason, and audit.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Self-approve where segregation is required or reuse approval for another command.

rules.title: Receipt is an immutable projection
rules.description: A receipt is a localized, versioned representation of committed facts with an integrity hash.
rules.trigger: A sale commits or a receipt is retrieved/reprinted.
rules.expectedBehavior: Regenerate presentation from the same authoritative snapshot.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Change sale facts during reprint or let printer failure roll back the sale.

rules.title: Digital receipt ownership
rules.description: Digital receipt access is account-bound; anonymous sales are print-only.
rules.trigger: A customer requests a receipt.
rules.expectedBehavior: Validate authenticated customer ownership without leaking foreign receipt existence.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Expose receipts by guessable identifier or attach one to an unverified customer.
exceptions: Authorized staff access follows explicit operational permission and audit.

rules.title: Online shift opening
rules.description: A physical-cash shift starts online and binds one device, register, drawer, operator, business, branch, currency, and policy snapshot.
rules.trigger: An operator opens a shift.
rules.expectedBehavior: Validate active resources, exclusivity, authorization, opening float, and idempotency atomically.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Open offline, attach to another operator's session, or reuse a permanent opening key.

rules.title: Append-only cash ledger
rules.description: Opening float, sales, refunds, movements, transfers, and corrections are immutable entries.
rules.trigger: Physical cash changes.
rules.expectedBehavior: Append an idempotent typed entry with actor, device, branch, source, reason, and correlation.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Rewrite balances or delete historical movements.

rules.title: Blind count before disclosure
rules.description: When policy requires blind counting, expected cash and variance remain hidden until count submission.
rules.trigger: A shift enters COUNTING.
rules.expectedBehavior: Recompute denomination totals server-side and append immutable count evidence.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Trust a client total or disclose expected cash before submission.
exceptions: Policy may permit total-only rather than denomination counting.

rules.title: Deterministic reconciliation
rules.description: Expected cash is the fold of immutable movements; variance is counted minus expected.
rules.trigger: A count is submitted.
rules.expectedBehavior: Classify variance by versioned policy and require reason or approval where applicable.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Create an unexplained balancing entry or fabricate MATCHED.

rules.title: Close waits for authoritative sync
rules.description: A shift cannot close while owned device commands or cash effects remain unsynchronized.
rules.trigger: Normal close is requested.
rules.expectedBehavior: Prove command completion, count, reconciliation, disposition, and approvals before CLOSED.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Close around pending events or infer missing cash later.
exceptions: Force-close is a separate exceptional audited path.

rules.title: Controlled force-close and reopen
rules.description: Force-close and reopen preserve prior evidence and append exceptional transitions.
rules.trigger: An authorized manager handles an exceptional shift.
rules.expectedBehavior: Require dedicated permission, reason, approval, state snapshot, alert, and audit.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Erase reconciliation or reopen as an ordinary movement path.

rules.title: Immutable inventory movements
rules.description: Stock history is represented by typed immutable movements; corrections are new movements.
rules.trigger: Stock is received, adjusted, reserved, released, transferred, counted, sold, or returned.
rules.expectedBehavior: Append branch-scoped movement and deterministically update projections.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Edit ledger history or directly rewrite an authoritative balance.

rules.title: Reservation bounded by availability
rules.description: Reservations cannot exceed available stock unless an explicit authorized negative-stock policy applies.
rules.trigger: Checkout preparation or reservation command.
rules.expectedBehavior: Validate variant, location, branch, quantity, availability, policy version, and idempotency.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Reserve foreign-tenant stock or silently bypass policy.
exceptions: POS v1 may warn and continue when advisory availability policy explicitly permits it.

rules.title: Inventory count posts only the difference
rules.description: A count compares observed quantity with the current projection and posts the delta.
rules.trigger: An authorized count is finalized.
rules.expectedBehavior: Retain observed quantity, prior projection, delta, actor, branch, reason, and version.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Replace history with the observed absolute value.

rules.title: Transfer has paired states
rules.description: A transfer removes owned on-hand quantity at origin and exposes in-transit quantity until destination receipt.
rules.trigger: A branch transfer is dispatched or received.
rules.expectedBehavior: Use a correlation identity, distinct locations, expected version, and paired immutable movements.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Count in-transit stock as available at both locations.

rules.title: Verified customer attachment
rules.description: Customer attachment uses UMI QR or verified phone and remains optional.
rules.trigger: An operator attaches a customer to checkout.
rules.expectedBehavior: Resolve through a safe UMI endpoint and bind only the authorized customer reference.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Store full phone offline or infer identity from unverified input.
exceptions: Anonymous checkout remains valid without loyalty or digital receipt.

rules.title: Loyalty authorize-commit-reverse
rules.description: Redemption reserves value, commits only with the order, and reverses on checkout failure.
rules.trigger: Reward, wallet, or gift-card value is applied.
rules.expectedBehavior: Use an idempotent authorization linked to the checkout and authoritative ledger.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Spend offline, double-spend, or leave value reserved after failed checkout.
exceptions: Offline sales may queue earn only.

rules.title: Authorization from current authoritative context
rules.description: Authentication identifies a principal; authorization resolves current membership, branch scope, permissions, entitlements, resource state, and device context.
rules.trigger: Any protected read or mutation.
rules.expectedBehavior: Deny by default and evaluate inside the authoritative tenant transaction.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Treat token claims, client tenant headers, or worker privilege as current authorization.

rules.title: No last active owner removal
rules.description: Membership changes cannot leave a business without an active owner.
rules.trigger: Owner role, scope, suspension, or revocation changes.
rules.expectedBehavior: Validate atomically and retain an audit record.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Revoke or downgrade the final active owner.

rules.title: Approval bound to exact consequence
rules.description: Fresh PIN and manager approval are short-lived, one-use, and bound to the exact command fingerprint.
rules.trigger: A consequential action crosses policy threshold.
rules.expectedBehavior: Resolve current approver authority, enforce segregation, and audit the decision.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Reuse, broaden, self-approve when prohibited, or approve after expiry.

rules.title: Offline capability allowlist
rules.description: Offline operation is explicitly capability-scoped by a signed opening snapshot.
rules.trigger: Connectivity is unavailable during an active shift.
rules.expectedBehavior: Allow only cash/manual-terminal sales, policy-bounded discounts, provisional print, local KDS, suspension, and pending earn.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Allow enrollment, shift start/close, redemption, integrated payment, refund, privileged cash movement, approval, or configuration offline.

rules.title: Durable ordered command journal
rules.description: The client persists cart and command identity before network or tender interaction and replays in device sequence.
rules.trigger: A mutation begins or connectivity returns.
rules.expectedBehavior: Encrypt locally, preserve fingerprints and snapshots, map provisional IDs, and surface conflicts.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Silently drop, reorder, duplicate, or reprice commands.

rules.title: KDS consumes committed kitchen truth
rules.description: Draft checkouts never reach KDS; committed orders project once into kitchen state.
rules.trigger: Checkout commit succeeds.
rules.expectedBehavior: Emit a versioned committed-order event and deduplicate by command/order identity.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Display drafts or duplicate provisional and official tickets.

rules.title: Durable signed LAN delivery
rules.description: Branch-paired POS and KDS persist signed envelopes and acknowledgements before reporting delivery.
rules.trigger: A committed offline/local order is sent to KDS.
rules.expectedBehavior: Validate certificate, branch, sequence, payload hash, version, and deduplicate message IDs.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Trust unsigned traffic or acknowledge before durable persistence.
rules.futureUmiOwner: packages/contract LAN schema and client adapters

rules.title: Exactly one kitchen fallback
rules.description: Missing KDS acknowledgement does not roll back a sale and produces one printer fallback ticket.
rules.trigger: Three bounded LAN retries receive no valid ACK.
rules.expectedBehavior: Keep the sale committed, warn the operator, print once, and retain reconciliation state.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Retry unboundedly, duplicate tickets, or reverse financial facts.

rules.title: Deterministic scoped reporting
rules.description: Reports derive from authoritative projections using explicit business, branch, timezone, business-date, currency, and policy versions.
rules.trigger: A report or Assistant read is requested.
rules.expectedBehavior: Use permission-safe read models and reconcile to immutable facts.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Mix tenants, silently use wall-clock dates, or recompute historical policy.

rules.title: Consequential facts are explainably audited
rules.description: Financial, permission, device, approval, override, and recovery actions emit structured, redacted audit facts.
rules.trigger: A consequential action is attempted or decided.
rules.expectedBehavior: Record actor, device, business, branch, command, resource, decision, reason, correlation, and outcome.
rules.forbiddenBehavior: Log secrets or replace audit facts with free-form text only.
